steps.en: Get the solver — a prebuilt binary, the C++ library, or the Python wrapper
steps.zh: 拿到求解器——预编译二进制、C++ 库，或 Python 封装

steps.en: Hand it a model: an MPS/LP file, or a matrix built through an API
steps.zh: 把模型交进去：MPS／LP 文件，或通过 API 建出的矩阵

steps.en: Presolves the model and picks simplex, interior point or the MIP branch-and-bound
steps.zh: 先做 presolve，再挑单纯形、内点法或 MIP 的分支定界

steps.en: Solves to optimality, or to your time limit, and reports the model status
steps.zh: 解到最优或到你的时间上限，并报告模型状态

steps.en: Read the solution back and act on it

value.en: You get LP/QP/MIP solved to optimality by a dependency-free MIT engine — no modelling DSL to learn
value.zh: 无需第三方依赖的 MIT 引擎替你解出 LP／QP／MIP 最优解，不必手搓求解器

sources: README → About HiGHS ("high performance serial and parallel solver for large scale sparse linear optimization problems"; "Thus HiGHS can solve linear programming (LP) problems, convex quadratic programming (QP) problems, and mixed integer programming (MIP) problems. It is mainly written in C++, but also has some C."; "No third-party dependencies are required.")
README → Build from source using CMake (`cmake -S . -B build`; `cmake --build build`; installs `bin/highs` and `lib/highs`)
README → Precompiled binaries (`*-mit` binary packages are MIT-licenced; `*-apache` packages contain HiGHS with HiPO and are Apache-licenced)
README → Running HiGHS ("HiGHS can read MPS files and (CPLEX) LP files"; `highs ml.mps`)
README → Command line options (`--model_file`, `--options_file`, `--time_limit float  Run time limit (seconds - double)`, `--solution_file`, `--threads`, `--parallel`)
README → Interfaces → Python (`pip install highspy`; depends on numpy), C, CSharp (`dotnet add package Highs.Native`), Fortran
